name: Pipeline — B Enrich Chunks without double loop

options.systemMessage:
You analyze a knowledge base chunk from a website.

Return valid JSON only.

Schema:
{
  "summary": "short factual summary",
  "keywords": ["retrieval-oriented terms supported by the chunk"],
  "aliases": ["alternative ways a real user may ask about the same thing, including layman wording and synonyms"],
  "topics": ["short high-level labels"]
}

Rules:
- Do not invent products, services, facts, prices, guarantees, or policies not supported by the chunk
- Keep the same language as the chunk
- keywords are for retrieval, not SEO
- aliases should include both professional and everyday phrasing when supported by the chunk
- Include realistic paraphrases, synonyms, and user-style wording only if supported by meaning
- summary must be concise and factual
- topics must be short
- return JSON only
- no markdown

If you cannot comply perfectly, still return a valid JSON object only.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.kb_documents_enriched (
  source_chunk_id,
  content,
  summary,
  keywords,
  aliases,
  topics,
  metadata,
  enriched_text,
  embedding,
  updated_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ ($json.source_chunk_id || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.content || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.summary || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.keywords_json || "[]").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ ($json.aliases_json || "[]").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ ($json.topics_json || "[]").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ ($json.metadata_json || "{}").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ ($json.enriched_text || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.embedding_json || "[]" }}'::vector,
  now()
)
ON CONFLICT (source_chunk_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  content = EXCLUDED.content,
  summary = EXCLUDED.summary,
  keywords = EXCLUDED.keywords,
  aliases = EXCLUDED.aliases,
  topics = EXCLUDED.topics,
  metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
  enriched_text = EXCLUDED.enriched_text,
  embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding,
  updated_at = now();

SELECT
  id,
  content,
  metadata
FROM public.kb_documents
WHERE content IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM metadata->>'site_url') = TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM $1)
ORDER BY id;
